---
title: "Bar chart with a count stat"
description: "A bar mark that counts rows per category: the count stat, used when no y is supplied."
categories: [Basics]
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helper.R")
```

Give `mark_bar()` a discrete `x` and no `y`, and it counts rows per category.

```{r}
peng <- na.omit(datasets::penguins)

p <- vplot(peng) |>
  mark_bar(x = species, fill = species) |>
  labs(title = "Counts per species (count stat)", y = "count")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p, "bars")
```
